reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named independent lab with a report for each batch is exactly what I check for. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one, and I'd read the report before ordering.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli, and a brand this new has no reviews I can read yet. I'd also want to confirm 200 mg is the right dose for me with my doctor.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report wasn't actually on the page or didn't match the label, I'd pass. Real customer reviews and a regular price closer to $25 would make me buy it again after the first box.
